metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the hyprland-config rice engine for Claude Code.

plugins.name: hyprland-config
plugins.description: A Hyprland rice engine for Claude Code: generate/edit/live-test the config, theme the whole desktop from one palette (named/wallpaper-generated/manual) via a self-contained rice engine with profiles and a user-override cascade, set wallpapers with dynamic theming, configure the terminal + desktop shell, and version-control it all in git — backing up and verifying after every change.
